correctness.rationale: Yu--Zhu give a complete explicit list of \(85\) lines on \(X_{-1/8}\). A standalone exact checker copies those equations into \(\mathbb Q(a,b,i)\), with \(a^4=2\), \(b^4=3\) and \(i^2=-1\), and evaluates all \(3570\) pairwise \(4\times4\) determinants. It obtains exactly \(850\) incidences and degree \(20\) at every line. Exact integer matrix multiplication verifies the six-factor annihilating polynomial and traces \(85,0,1700,3180,210644,2821740\); symmetry and the Vandermonde system force the claimed multiplicities. Shifting by \(-3\) gives rank \(39\) and inertia \((1,38,46)\), agreeing with the source rank.

value.rationale: The exact spectrum is a structural invariant of the current record \(85\)-line quintic configuration. It replaces a black-box rank datum by a complete spectral explanation, identifies the \(46\)-dimensional relation space and the nonzero signature of the line presentation, and supplies a reproducible exact incidence benchmark directly relevant to Néron--Severi lattice calculations. The result is substantially more informative than recomputing the already published rank.
